[///] came [till?] now. I [///]
have made the remaining costs(?). Not yet has any man
[///]. It would be nice if you
cause 6 (silver) kite to be brought to me, until one will serve(?) me
within my house. Amun, the great god, will not allow
that the priest of Osiris will be worried(?). If people are coming to me here
who will be brought before the priest of Osiris, or if I (myself)
travel to the south, I will bring them to your place,
without anything having perished at the hand of the priest of Osiris.
One knows the excellent instruction. For the translation cf. Den Brinker / Muhs / Vleeming, DBL (2005), 54. Written in the 13th regnal year, 7th of Epeiph.
